title: Arbitrary code execution via yaml.load on user-supplied config
description: config/loader.py parses user-uploaded configuration files with yaml.load(data) using the default Loader rather than safe_load. A crafted document using Python object tags (for example !!python/object/apply:os.system) executes arbitrary commands during deserialization. load_config() should call yaml.safe_load. The path is reachable from the /import endpoint, which accepts an uploaded .yml file.
